o: Capt. Kerry Titheradge sets sail on a new adventure as he takes the helm of motor yacht Azul V in Phuket, Thailand. Surrounded by breathtaking islands and world-renowned beaches, Capt. Kerry and his crew strive to deliver excellent white-glove service while adapting to a new environment.

v.n: SNEAK PEEK: Your First Look At The Below Deck Season 13…

eps.t: What A Thai To Be Alive
eps.o: Capt. Kerry welcomes a fresh crew aboard Azul V for a new season, but new power dynamics on the interior and exterior teams put their chemistry to the test right away. With engine trouble threatening to delay departure before the season even begins, can the crew pull it together or will the first charter send them off course?
Rainbeau’s management style causes tension with the interior. Chef Moe plays cupid and his arrow strikes several crew members, but not everyone is feeling the love.

Demanding guests with lengthy preference sheets cause problems for Chef Moe and the interior. Matt steps up on deck while Alex makes mistakes, causing Capt. Kerry to question leadership in the exterior. Kaylee and Matt chart a way forward. Jessenia is unsure if she wants to pursue things with Alex.
